MissionSettings.Author: David Fung & Jason Janicki
MissionSettings.Blurb: Colonel Renard has requested a meeting with the Mandrissa. However, due to her ill health, she is unable to attend and has chosen to send her son in her place. She has also decided that you will be his escort to the meeting. This is not an honor given lightly; the loss of Lord Cho would be the end of a proud lineage. We do not expect any trouble, but Renard is  . . . unpredictable. Stay alert, Commander, Lady Cho will be watching.
